info.text:
In NYC, landlords often want a lease guarantor with yearly income of 80x the monthly rent, double the tenant's 40x (StreetEasy).
Hypothetical $2,000 rent: tenant $80,000 a year at 40x; guarantor $160,000 at 80x. A common 3x monthly screen elsewhere: $72,000 a year.
A record 49% of renter households were cost-burdened in 2024 (Harvard JCHS 2026). Apartment List's national median rent was $1,388 in September 2026.
Guarantors can owe unpaid rent, damages and often legal fees. Insurent's fee is about 70-90% of one month's rent for a 1-year lease.
Sources: StreetEasy; Harvard JCHS State of the Nation's Housing 2026; Apartment List; Insurent.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
